_README: Hand-curated adjustments for information the statistical feeds lag on.
Every field is optional; only include what you actually want to change.
name                  must match the player's name in the projection feed
availability          expected share of the season active, 0..1
games_missed          alternative to availability, expressed in games out of 17
points_multiplier     scales the projected season total (role/usage news)
volatility_multiplier scales outcome spread (raises ceiling AND floor risk)
tag                   free label shown on the board: injury / sleeper / fade
note                  one line of reasoning, printed next to the player
IMPORTANT: the projection feed already prices in known injuries - a back on
IR is projected far below his healthy rate - so only override when you
believe the feed is actually wrong or stale. Re-check before draft day.
